There are a few things to remember. The most important is that gnomes are paired. GREEN and BROWN. RED and PURPLE. Each round starts with one gnome of each pair (Example round: Green gnome or purple gnome). The second thing to remember is that at the beginning of the game you should choose one pair and stick with it until you start earning below 4+ mushrooms (2+ or lower, start choosing different gnomes pair).
An example: If I choose a GREEN AND BROWN pair. I keep choosing GREEN gnome or BROWN gnome until I'm collecting 4+ or higher amount of mushrooms. If I start collecting less than 2+ or lower in mushrooms, I start choosing RED gnome or PURPLE gnome. Stick to your pair until your pair doesn't earn you mushrooms anymore. 
Important: DON'T forget to press "space" key each time you are in the forest in see the basket, as I found it rather forgetful.
Best of luck!
